test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
Here, the wrongly spelt word is **Discripancy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 
 
Option 3 i.e. **"Discripancy"** is spelt incorrectly.

 
 
• 
 
The correct spelling of the word is** 'Discrepancy'** which means a lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts or things. ((दो बातों में) असंगति, अंतर (दो समान चीजों मे))

 
 
• 
 
**Example:** *There is a **discrepancy**__ between these two sets of figures.*

 
 
 
 
• 
 
 So, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Indispensable** is spelt correctly and means absolutely necessary or essential. (बहुत आवश्‍यक, जिसके बिना काम न चल सके; अपरिहार्य; अनिवार्य)
 
• **Tyranny** is spelt correctly and means cruel and oppressive government or rule. (जनता पर ज़ुल्‍म, अत्‍याचार (किसी व्‍यक्ति या समूह द्वारा किसी देश या राज्‍य पर अधिकार करने के लिए निर्मम और अन्‍यायपूर्ण बलप्रयोग))
 
• **Pastime** is spelt correctly and means an activity done for enjoyment or pleasure. (मनबहलाव के लिए ख़ाली समय में किया गया कार्य)

1c7:T9e6,
The correct answer is** 'Free from difficulties and dangers.'**
